geometry.target: Current target row frame intersected with app frame, physical-left/top insertion band
geometry.namedSheet: Use the existing torah-inspector-sheet container as a boundary only if its current frame contains the live reader and begins on the physical right of the app; crop the row band when it overlaps the insertion Y
geometry.fallback: If the full-sheet AX frame is absent or ambiguous, rely explicitly on the pinned physical-right layout; retain live target existence/hittability and require the chosen point outside the live reader segment
geometry.failurePolicy: No usable live row or no uncovered band fails the test before dragging. No fallback replaces any native-result assertion.
geometry.appleAttachments: Actual app/row/reader/inspector frames, point and chosen geometry mode plus a pre-gesture screenshot are retained.

preservedAssertions: Distinct native quote and original target IDs
Exact source and original target text
scope: One source-only XCUITest addition plus its geometry correction. No claim of actual AX visibility, drag recognition, insertion, source association or cold reopen success until Apple execution.
